**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in MYBPC3 with a minor allele frequency greater than 1% in gnomAD across all populations would falsify the claim that MYBPC3 is a causal gene for these rare diseases. _(variant: HGNC:7551)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared genetic basis in MYBPC3 provides a unified target for therapeutic strategies aimed at improving sarcomere function and mitigating cardiac dysfunction in patients with either disease.
